def wildcard_match(pattern: str, text: str) -> bool:
    p_ptr = 0
    t_ptr = 0
    star_idx = -1
    match_ptr = 0

    while t_ptr < len(text):
        # Characters match, or pattern has '?'
        if p_ptr < len(pattern) and (pattern[p_ptr] == text[t_ptr] or pattern[p_ptr] == '?'):
            p_ptr += 1
            t_ptr += 1
        # Pattern has '*'
        elif p_ptr < len(pattern) and pattern[p_ptr] == '*':
            star_idx = p_ptr
            match_ptr = t_ptr
            p_ptr += 1
        # Last pattern character was '*', backtrack to try matching more characters
        elif star_idx != -1:
            p_ptr = star_idx + 1
            match_ptr += 1
            t_ptr = match_ptr
        # Current characters don't match and no previous '*'
        else:
            return False

    # Check for any remaining characters in pattern, which must all be '*'
    while p_ptr < len(pattern) and pattern[p_ptr] == '*':
        p_ptr += 1

    return p_ptr == len(pattern)
